# Selam — AI operator for your Mac

> Selam is an autonomous AI operator that lives on your Mac. You set a goal once; she
> directs her own sub-agents, runs work overnight, reaches people across WhatsApp,
> Telegram, iMessage and Email, and reports back what got done. You choose her face,
> voice, and name. She asks before anything irreversible.

## What she does
- Drafts documents, manages email + calendar, takes meeting notes, answers and places phone calls
- Runs autonomously overnight and reports the results
- On-device 3D avatar (no cloud avatar subscription); on-device face & voice recognition
- Native macOS document skills (Pages, Numbers, Keynote, Word, Excel, Notes)
- Built-in crypto wallet (BTC / ETH / USDC / USDT) — off by default; spoken approval + hard caps
- 22 built-in games, a live Party Trivia host, guided meditation and soundscapes
- Selam Studio: hand her a script and she performs it as captioned video clips
- Hosts a live AI news broadcast on YouTube (@Selam_AI_Agent)

## Privacy & safety
- Runs on your Mac; API keys live in your macOS Keychain; conversations go straight from
  your Mac to your chosen AI providers — no Selam server in the loop
- Every action that touches the outside world passes through an approval gate
- Memory/identity files are plain Markdown you own and can export anytime

## Pricing
- $10 for a 30-day trial, then $89 to own it forever ($99 total; or $99 outright)
- First 12 months of updates free; optional $99/yr update pass afterward
- Pay by card or crypto (Bitcoin)

## Platforms
- macOS 14+ (Apple silicon recommended) today; Windows in Q3; mobile companion later
